actions.action: Require acknowledgment before completing a key handoff
actions.mechanism: Separate proposed transfers from confirmed receipt, retaining the last confirmed holder while explicitly showing uncertainty.
actions.implementation: Give only the two volunteers access. Sender selects “Offer key”; recipient selects “Received” and records handoff time. Allow one pending transfer.
actions.check: Offer without acknowledgment: the display must show the last confirmed holder and unresolved transfer. Acknowledge: holder and handoff time must update.
actions.risk: An unrecorded physical transfer can still make the display stale.

actions.action: Replace chat searching with one pinned key record
actions.mechanism: An append-only handoff history supplies a single current summary without silently erasing disputed or corrected entries.
actions.implementation: Pin a shared record showing last confirmed holder, handoff time, and unresolved transfers. Record corrections as linked entries; regenerate the summary.
actions.check: Enter two completed transfers, then correct one timestamp. Verify the current holder remains correct and both timestamp versions remain inspectable.
actions.risk: Maintaining a separate chat-based record would recreate conflicting sources.

actions.action: Escalate overdue handoffs into explicit reconciliation
actions.mechanism: A deadline surfaces missing acknowledgment without automatically treating silence as receipt or cancellation.
actions.implementation: Have the volunteers choose an acknowledgment window. Flag overdue transfers and notify both. Resolve through timestamped receipt, sender-confirmed non-transfer, or an explicit dispute.
actions.check: Let an offer expire. Verify it remains unresolved, both volunteers are notified, and no holder change occurs solely from elapsed time.
actions.risk: Reminders cannot establish physical possession when volunteers disagree.
